title: A mirror draws most babies by six months on the CDC list
summary: Most babies like to look at themselves in a mirror by six months, the CDC says.
body: Liking a look at oneself in a mirror sits on CDC's six-month social checklist. Curiosity about the reflection is the skill, not saying a name. CDC reviewed that page on 16 May 2026 and warns that Learn the Signs pages are not validated screening instruments.

sources.title: Milestones by 6 Months
sources.author: CDC
sources.note: Supports 'Likes to look at self in a mirror' by six months for most children (75% or more).
